categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the Private Broadcast label and directly impacts transaction origin privacy during relay.
categories.rationale: Fixes a transaction origin privacy leak where nodes running with `-privatebroadcast` inadvertently serve locally retained dropped transactions to clearnet peers. Commit 6d5450244b notes that when the network drops a transaction, holding and serving it alone marks it as the node's own, defeating private broadcast protections.

categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Labeled Wallet and modifies wallet rebroadcast logic in src/wallet/wallet.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.h.
categories.rationale: Prevents the wallet from resubmitting unconfirmed transactions to the local mempool during startup, imports, and periodic rebroadcasts under `-privatebroadcast`. As cited in the PR description and issue #3828, automatic rebroadcasting can cause incoming dust payments or dropped transactions to be broadcast over clearnet, compromising user privacy.
